lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Ni2 (reduced formula Mg3Ni) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg and Ni centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments include 12 Mg neighbors, 8 Mg and 4 Ni neighbors, and 9 Mg and 3 Ni neighbors, while Ni centers have 12 Mg neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra, with Mg–Ni pairs sharing edges.
